scope: Focused review of the GDP dispute after the midterms, birthright citizenship, federal prosecutor appointments, Iowa sampling, Florida storm response and early Republican nomination signals. Iran funding, federal outage recovery, congressional records, election certification and campaign organization received limited checks.
summary: Trump called for a probe of a GDP estimate that the government revised on a schedule announced before the election. Judge Christopher Cooper blocked Trump’s revised birthright citizenship order for children covered by the lawsuit. The Ninth Circuit temporarily paused Bill Essayli’s disqualification from supervising prosecutions. EPA continued testing after the Iowa detonation, and Trump approved relief for earlier Florida flooding. Barstool founder Dave Portnoy publicly favored Ron DeSantis. The November 23 nomination estimates and all personnel forecasts carry forward. The following outcomes remain pending or unverified. Iowa laboratory results, Formal GDP inquiry, FinCEN service restoration, Iran tanker damage and U.S. military orders, EU budget talks leave a Ukraine loan pending, Epstein records vote and production, Separate signed Alaska election certification, Venezuela election timetable, Thanksgiving storm power restoration, Huang and Teter’s December congressional appearances, Contractors’ responses to Congress, Lisa Cook’s removal hearing, Ueland and LoSapio confirmation, Reported CIA system breach and Huang clearance. Coverage of early-state organizing, new Iran funding language, clearance decisions and financial reporting recovery was limited. Open from November 26: Reported shelving of U.S.–Russia business proposals. Open from November 26: Representative Jimmy Gomez’s announced December 1 resignation. Open from November 26: Mississippi election disputes.

challenges.alternative: The timing of the GDP revision shows deliberate election interference.
challenges.finding: The bureau set November 25 as the revision date in February. The White House praised the initial result and the bureau published its second estimate as scheduled.
challenges.consequence: A predictable revision carries the evidentiary weight. Trump’s demand remains a political fact whose official consequences are open.

priorities.importance: The answer affects who controls the production and oversight of federal statistics.
priorities.current_answer: The bureau followed its published schedule. Trump’s demand is documented and a formal inquiry remains unverified.

explanations.explanation: The release date was chosen after the election to hide growth.

explanations.discriminating_observation: Look for verified departures from the bureau’s published procedures.

nominee_review.reason: Regular weekly cadence. No weekly wargame executed in this daily review.
nominee_review.summary: The November 23 forecast carries forward. Barstool Sports founder Dave Portnoy publicly favored Florida Governor Ron DeSantis over Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. His remarks show how one media figure weighs ties to Trump. Whether voters, donors and organizers make the same comparison remains open.

editorial_notes: Used concrete actors and actions in every new event title. Distinguished scheduled statistical revisions from an inquiry, EPA’s early readings from laboratory results, judicial stays from merits rulings, and a commentator’s preference from campaign support. Existing scenario labels were carried forward.
Identified the two public critics of Vance’s Iowa explanation and distinguished their objections from CBS’s attributed accounts of private blame.
validation_results: Checked new episode IDs, source URLs, relevant issue paths, nomination shares and personnel forecast holds. Runner preflight supplies the final staged contract check.

The slicer found each staged new episode by its own ID and did not surface a second episode for any of the six. The event review also checked the nearby Iowa disposal entry separately from later EPA sampling.
